item.title: Mullins honored at State DAR Conference
item.description: Retired Lt. Col. Paul Mullins received a Quilt of Valor at the Alabama State DAR Conference, honoring his 29-year Army career in aviation, special operations and community service.

item.title: OPL hosts storytime with Westview
item.description: Opp Public Library and Westview Baptist Church host twice-monthly kids’ storytime, blending Dr. Seuss read-alouds with crafts to build early literacy and community ties.

item.title: City of Andy approves agreement with C-Spire
item.description: Andalusia approves 25-year franchise with C-Spire, paving way for a new fiber network and more internet options for residents and businesses by 2026–27.

item.title: Bulldogs’ tennis teams sweep Bobcats at home
item.description: Andalusia tennis sweeps Opp on the road as girls go 9-0 and boys 6-0, giving the Bulldogs a confidence boost ahead of their March 12 match with Northside Methodist Academy.

item.title: CCS students take a trip to Alabama Aviation College
item.description: CCS career coaches led students on a hands-on tour of Alabama Aviation College, exploring aviation maintenance and technical training options for post-graduation careers.

item.title: SAINTS SHOWCASE SKILLS
item.description: LBW Community College’s fifth annual Saints on Stage variety show brought students, alumni and the community together for music, dance, comedy and a drama department People’s Choice win.

item.title: Wednesday | March 11, 2026 E-edition
item.description: Explore the full digital version of our March 11, 2026 issue and stay updated with the latest news and features.

item.title: Shawn M. Greiner Obituary
item.description: Navy veteran, mechanic and fisherman Shawn M. Greiner of Swinney Switch, Texas, born in Corpus Christi in 1958, died March 5, 2026; he is remembered by siblings, daughters and extended family.

item.title: Pat Greathouse
item.description: Andalusia’s Pat Greathouse, 81, died March 9; services are Friday, March 13 at Foreman Funeral Home, with visitation Thursday and burial at Adellum Baptist Church cemetery.

item.title: AIR Artists to host Fiesta Española
item.description: AIR Artists’ third Fiesta Española gala on April 4, 2026, at the L&N Train Depot features flamenco, dinner, and a silent auction of curated trips benefiting AIR Artists Inc.
